title: Plan the initial fantasy project backlog
description:
## Context

The operator requested a full /abacus-plan session for /home/ddc/dev-environment/fantasy and explicitly confirmed Full on 2026-09-08. The repository has no application code. The operator supplied git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git as its remote; origin is configured and the remote has no advertised refs. Its tracker initialization is committed.

## Scope

Follow /home/ddc/.claude/skills/abacus-plan/SKILL.md to define the product and first useful release, then produce an approved execution-ready backlog. Full is warranted because product scope, domain assumptions, interfaces, and architecture remain unknown. The current substage is FRAMING; no product or architecture decisions have been approved.

Maintain the single in-flight record PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md, registered by docs-corpus.json under inflight_globs. Append each Full substage and commit each gate deliverable. Obtain operator approval of FRAMING, RESEARCH, ARCHITECTURE, TEST-STRATEGY, RECORD, and DECOMPOSITION before advancing. Use docs/adr/ for durable architecture decisions when warranted. Delete the in-flight record at approved execution handoff after preserving its substance in beads and any durable decision records.

## Open Questions

Q1: What should the product help someone do, for whom, and what is the first useful outcome?
Q2 resolved: The operator supplied git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git; origin is configured to that URL.
User stories, non-goals, the epic product success metric, the narrowest useful release, and prerequisites will be established with the operator from Q1. Prerequisites are unassessed, not confirmed absent. Implementation paths and symbols must be determined during approved planning.

## File footprint

.beads/issues.jsonl, docs-corpus.json, PLANNING-fantasy-p55.md. Later planning may create warranted records under docs/adr/; their exact paths and scope must be recorded before authoring.

## Test Spec

[no-test] This epic currently changes planning documents and tracker/corpus metadata only, with no application code path. Validate the corpus JSON and in-flight registration, inspect git diff, and run br lint --status all. Each eventual code child must specify unit and real-composition integration tests, concrete inputs and assertions, verification commands, and its full file footprint. Measure any existing full suite during TEST-STRATEGY and estimate proposed additions against the 30-second full-suite budget.

## Success Criteria

The operator has approved the tier and all required stage gates. The resulting children pass the Fresh Agent Test, include requirements-directed dependencies and unit/integration test contracts, and have zero unresolved questions. Check br dep tree, br ready, and br lint before handoff. Planning and tracker state are committed and pushed to the confirmed remote. Execution is not launched as part of planning.
acceptance_criteria: The operator has approved the tier and all required stage gates; the resulting child beads pass the Fresh Agent Test, include requirements-directed dependencies and unit/integration test contracts, and have zero unresolved questions. Planning and tracker state are committed and pushed to the confirmed remote. Execution is not launched as part of planning.
notes: [no-test] Full was explicitly approved by the operator on 2026-09-08 ("yes, let's run full"). Current stage: FRAMING, awaiting product intent and intended user. The tier question is resolved. Q1 product scope remains open. Q2 Git remote was resolved by the operator: git@github.com:DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git; origin is configured. Read-only inspection confirmed the remote has no advertised refs. No implementation children or product decisions are approved. Initial tracker state is committed at 2f4b8cc. The local tracker was initialized using an explicit --db path after plain br init selected the parent workspace; that tooling observation is captured in jot.
